comment: sorafenib is a small-molecule RAF kinase inhibitor (chemical). Raf1 and pRaf1 are mapped to the RAF1 protein (pRaf1 represents a modified form but is returned as the base protein name per guidance to avoid modification labels). Names are common synonyms (up to three) for lookup.
